Subject: Request: Retroactive sandbox credit + trial extension for Atlas Data

Hi Diego,

Quick note — our onboarding was delayed because the SAML integration took longer than expected. We exhausted the free sandbox earlier than planned and would like to request a retroactive credit to cover the unused trial days (May 18–June 3) and a two-week extension on the trial window so the team can finish benchmarking.

Can Redwood issue a credit memo that can be applied against our next invoice? If possible we prefer the credit to be processed as a promotion/allowance rather than a refund. Also please advise if you need the original invoice numbers to apply a direct offset.

Thanks,
Maya R.
Head of Platform — Atlas Data
Attachments: none
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood-inference.com>

Subject: Re: Request: Retroactive sandbox credit + trial extension for Atlas Data

Hi Maya — thanks for the note and sorry to hear about the integration delays. I can kick off the credit routing.

Two quick asks so we can move this through finance:
- Please confirm which invoice(s) you want the credit applied to (if you have a preference). If not, we can issue a promotional credit to be consumed against the next invoice.
- Would you accept a credit memo issued as a promo allowance (contra-revenue path) rather than a cash refund? This is our preferred accounting treatment for trials.

Looping in Laura and Marcus from Finance/Revenue Ops to confirm the ledger and timing. Laura — suggested amount is the unused portion equivalent to 17 trial days; Maya, if you can confirm the dollar sum or let us calculate from usage we’ll include it in the memo.

Next steps: I’ll get a draft credit memo to you once Finance confirms classification and GLA.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>

Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Retroactive sandbox credit + trial extension for Atlas Data

Hi all — happy to take this.

We typically handle these as promotional allowances (contra revenue) so the customer receives a credit memo that reduces future billed charges. Operational items:
- If you want a direct invoice offset we need the invoice number(s) to apply the credit to; otherwise we’ll issue a reusable credit memo valid for 90 days.
- Please confirm the USD amount you want credited. If Diego/Maya want us to calculate, we’ll use the trial-day rate times unused days and supply the breakdown.
- Suggested GLA mapping: 6800-Promo-Allowance. See attached GLA_mapping.csv and a blank credit memo template (credit_memo_template.pdf).

If Finance approves, Marcus please confirm approval and whether to process as a journal entry vs. manual offset on the billing system. Also advise any tax notes (should be non-taxable promo in the US).

Laura Bennett
Sr. Accounting Manager — Redwood Inference
Attachments: credit_memo_template.pdf (template), GLA_mapping.csv (suggested ledger mapping)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood-inference.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com, diego_fernandez@redwood-inference.com
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Retroactive sandbox credit + trial extension for Atlas Data

Laura — reviewed and approved.

Routing guidance:
- Classification: promotional allowance (contra revenue) is approved.
- Ledger: use 6800-Promo-Allowance as suggested.
- Processing: issue a credit memo in the billing system and create a reversing journal (approved_credit_journal_stub.txt attached) to clear the allowance. If the customer specifies invoice #4532 for application, we will post an invoice offset on that invoice rather than a reusable memo.
- Expiry: set the credit memo expiry to 90 days from issuance.

Once Laura posts the memo, please confirm so Diego can send the signed acceptance to DocuSign.

Marcus Lin
Revenue Operations Manager — Redwood Inference
Attachments: approved_credit_journal_stub.txt
